responsibility: Implements RTL dead code elimination, including the fast backwards liveness-based deletion of unnecessary instructions and related helper entry points used directly by the DF framework. The file defines which nonjump insns and certain calls/clobbers are deletable, performs mark-and-sweep over instruction dependencies with support for debug info and optional CFG alteration, provides both register-level and word-level variants, and registers the standalone "rtl_dce" pass as well as utility routines like run_fast_df_dce and run_word_dce.
same_name_distinction: Contains the actual RTL dead-code-elimination pass implementation and pass registration, whereas gcc/dce.h is only the thin declaration layer. This .cc file decides which insns are deletable, runs the backward liveness/mark-and-sweep algorithms, handles CFG-sensitive deletion cases, and defines the runnable fast/word-level DCE entry points.
